professionalSummary.text: Platform owner for the delivery division's cloud platform (AWS, three accounts) for two and a half years, with responsibility for production infrastructure changes and change board leadership.
professionalSummary.witness: Owned the delivery division's cloud platform (AWS, three accounts) for two and a half years, deciding and executing production infrastructure changes myself as the named platform owner, with each change record carrying my approval and execution.

experienceHighlights.text: Kept Terraform code, deployment pipelines for tracking and dispatch services, and cost controls (account budgets, tagging policy, monthly right-sizing pass) in shape.
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the Terraform code, the deployment pipelines for the tracking and dispatch services and the cost controls (account budgets, the tagging policy and a monthly right-sizing pass) in shape.

experienceHighlights.text: Chaired fortnightly change board with four service team leads, decided what went into production window, and kept minutes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Chaired the fortnightly change board with the four service team leads; I decided what went into the production window and kept the minutes.

experienceHighlights.text: Worked changes through with service teams and finance, with minutes recording service configuration with service teams, budget approval with finance, and platform/production window decisions with the candidate.
experienceHighlights.witness: Worked changes through with the service teams and finance; the minutes record that service configuration stayed with the service teams, budget approval with finance, and the platform and the production window with me.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Service-catalogue page listing candidate as platform owner with a month of change records approved and executed under candidate's user ID, including change-tool identifiers for traceability.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the service-catalogue page listing the candidate as platform owner and a month of change records approved and executed under the candidate's user id; change-tool identifiers are included so the records can be traced.

skills.text: AWS cloud platform management (three accounts), Terraform, deployment pipelines, cost controls (account budgets, tagging policy, monthly right-sizing pass), change board leadership.
skills.witness: Owned the delivery division's cloud platform (AWS, three accounts) for two and a half years, deciding and executing production infrastructure changes myself as the named platform owner, with each change record carrying my approval and execution.

The materials do not establish the candidate's direct ownership of the tracking and dispatch services, the exact duration of the change board meetings, or the specific metrics for cost controls.

evidence.text: Two and a half years as the delivery division's platform owner: production changes, Terraform, cost controls and the change board.

evidence.text: Kept the Terraform code, the deployment pipelines for the tracking and dispatch services and the cost controls (account budgets, the tagging policy and a monthly right-sizing pass) in shape.

evidence.text: Chaired the fortnightly change board with the four service team leads; I decided what went into the production window and kept the minutes.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of chairing the board, deciding on production window, and keeping minutes.

evidence.text: Two and a half years as the delivery division's platform owner: production changes, Terraform, cost controls and the change board.

Worked changes through with the service teams and finance; the minutes record that service configuration stayed with the service teams, budget approval with finance, and the platform and the production window with me.
